[RARC.7.1] An input's path through the engine, from the integrator's call to
the events on the stream, is the consumption loop's ([RARC.5.6]). The input is
applied to working memory ([RARC.5.6.4]) and propagated through the network to
the agenda ([RARC.5.6.5]). During a pump, activations fire one at a time
([RARC.5.6.6]), and every event, the input's and each derived one, reaches the
stream callback in the order it was processed, each action's change propagated
before the next action runs ([RARC.5.6.8]). Facts an action asserts re-enter
the same path. The call returns when the loop is done ([RARC.5.6.1]).
